recognize_zh: 周邊血中一團約七顆互相擠壓成多角形的大型母細胞，核染色質細緻、細胞質少且呈淡藍色，左下另有一顆單獨母細胞，背景有標靶紅血球，符合 CML 急性轉化。
features: Aggregate of about seven large blasts molded into polygonal shapes
High N:C ratio with finely granular, open chromatin and faint nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Isolated additional blast at lower left
Background red cells with occasional target cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an aggregate of large blasts molded against one another, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, faint nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. An additional isolated blast is present, and background red cells include occasional target cells. No Auer rods are identified. In the setting of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, findings are consistent with blast phase; lineage cannot be determined morphologically.

ddx.vs: Agranular blasts with scant cytoplasm raise lymphoid lineage, which requires flow cytometry (CD19, CD10, TdT) to confirm.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor in blood
ddx.vs: Tumor cells in blood are rare and form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and lack CD45, whereas leukemic blasts are CD45 positive.
Morphology overlaps, and history of chronic phase and BCR-ABL1 testing are needed.
